brief: Goldman Sachs flow strategists Hafif, Garrett and Coppersmith report that investors cut US equity exposure across segments and sectors through 8/28 while index and single stock volatility repriced lower. AAII bears averaged above 40 for four weeks and the GS Sentiment Indicator fell to +0.27 from +1.1, a neutral positioning reading. Hedge fund net leverage fell 0.7 points to 47.6%, the 1st percentile of a year, and all defensive sectors were net sold, the largest defensive selling since April 2025. Against that, the GS Panic Index reads 0.73/10 and SPX 1m implied vol sits in the 3rd percentile, so the vol market prices almost no risk-off. Goldman reads the combination as investors positioned and waiting for an event to bring markets lower, and calls that complacency too tilted to an anticipated leg lower. Lighter positioning, buyback volumes at 1.2x 2025 YTD ADTV and $9.51bn of systematic re-risking give a cleaner set-up for a chop higher into mid-month, before the ~9/15 blackout window and the worst two-week seasonal period. Favored trades are SPY 18Sep26 780 calls at $2.29 and an SPX 20Nov26 95% lookback put at 1.51% as a hedge through mid-terms.
